remarks: Discover the Best of Downtown Stamford Living! This stunning 3-bedroom townhouse combines elegance, style, and unbeatable convenience, all with its own private entrance. The open-concept design is perfect for entertaining, featuring a cozy gas fireplace, gleaming hardwood floors, and expansive 10' ceilings that add a sense of grandeur. Sunlight streams through oversized windows, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Step onto your private balcony to grill or simply unwind. Located just steps from Stamford's vibrant restaurants, movie theaters, and the train station, this home offers unparalleled access to everything downtown has to offer. Complete with an attached two-car garage and full-sized upper-level laundry, this townhouse is designed for modern living at its finest.
